title: Local Strengthening of the Main Deck Cargo Door Surround Frames on the Freighter
abstract: Frame strengthening on the right-hand side of the freighter main deck cargo door cut-out, sized for the door-open ground load case with the aircraft on jacks during nose-in loading operations.

sections.reason: Ground load survey work on the freighter showed that the main deck cargo door aperture sees a torsional case during nose-in loading that the passenger fuselage never sees: the door is open, the aircraft is partly on jacks, and the loader bridge reacts against the sill. The as-designed frame standard met the flight cases with margin but showed a reserve factor of 1.02 against the ground case at the upper aft corner. This is a design completion item raised by the freighter certification programme and is not connected to any in-service event.
sections.description: Frames on the right-hand side of the main deck cargo door aperture receive a heavier machined rib D5321005304351 in place of the sheet-formed item, and a new upper cleat D5321118422296 is introduced at each of the three frame stations that carry the sill beam reaction. The frame-to-stringer attachments in the affected bays are re-fastened with countersunk rivets AES645587-2A at a reduced pitch. General arrangement is on drawing D53210052179. All work is inside the right-hand forward cargo zones 123 and 125 and is done on the production line before the main deck floor is installed. Nothing on the left-hand side of the aircraft and nothing on the door itself is changed.
sections.effects: Mass increase of 11.8 kg per aircraft, entirely on the right-hand side, giving a small lateral asymmetry that is absorbed in the freighter weight and balance manual without operational restriction. No electrical load change. Not interchangeable: the rib and cleat cannot be fitted to the passenger frame standard. No new maintenance task and no change to the door opening procedure. Illustrated parts content for the freighter differential configuration requires a new sheet.
sections.embodiment_note: Production only for the time being. Cut in at MSN M00320. A retrofit path exists for the four freighters delivered before cut-in through Service Bulletin MRD-53-1055, which needs the main deck floor panels lifted and is realistically a heavy check activity.

type_data.balance_impact: Right-hand side only, lateral moment recorded in the freighter weight and balance manual
type_data.production_impact: Cut-in at MSN M00320 ahead of main deck floor installation, no line stoppage
